paper_a.title: Consistent Hashing for Distributed Caches

sections.text: Consistent hashing minimizes key remapping when nodes are added or removed from a distributed cache, unlike naive modulo hashing which remaps nearly all keys. [TABLE_t1]
Virtual nodes improve load balance across physical nodes by mapping each physical node to many points on the hash ring.

paper_a.abstract: A short paper on consistent hashing.

paper_b.title: Circuit Breakers in Distributed Systems

sections.text: A circuit breaker prevents cascading failures by tripping to an OPEN state after repeated failures, then probing recovery via a HALF_OPEN state.
Exponential backoff with jitter reduces thundering-herd retries after a circuit breaker trips. [TABLE_t2]
